samples.question: The upper strip has the same circle, square, and triangle on both sides of a missing center. Each lower colored frame is a candidate insert. In a candidate, follow each colored route from its left port to its right port; route colors only help tracing. Without rotating or flipping, which frame reconnects every left shape to the identical right shape? Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
